notes: Municipal bond manager performance page whose composite tables are complete and properly paired, carrying a capital-safety claim the page's own 2022 figures contradict and a model track record with no methodology, assumptions or limitations.

planted.span: With Marrowby Glen, your principal is safe: our high-grade municipal portfolios protect capital in every market environment.
planted.explanation: The claim is untrue on the page's own figures, which show a -6.5% net return in 2022, and it contradicts the risk section's statement that bond prices fall when rates rise.

planted.span: Applied to historical market data from 2006 through 2025, the Tactical Duration model would have returned 4.7% a year against 3.2% for the Index, beating it in 15 of 20 years.
planted.explanation: Model performance for a strategy with no live accounts is presented without the criteria and assumptions used to calculate it or any statement of the risks and limitations of relying on it.
